tagline: This app: a WebXR city on your desk built from a code repo, where a failing test sets a building on fire.

source.note: Built from this project's own src/**/*.ts at the time `npm run city` last ran.

districts.root: The app entry: creates the IWSDK world, registers systems and wires the pieces together.
districts.city: Reads a city JSON file and builds the miniature city: districts, buildings, floors and streets.
districts.ui: Panels and labels drawn in the headset: the guide, code cards and test results.
districts.fx: Visual effects such as the fire on a building with a failing test.
districts.input: Hand tracking: pinching, poking and grabbing the city with bare hands.
districts.mr: Mixed reality: finding the real table and placing the city on it.

guide.intro: This is Repo City's own code. Each building is a source file, each floor a function, and streets are imports.
guide.onFire: Nothing is burning here: no tests are failing.
